extDescription.message: Stop YouTube from refreshing your home feed when returning from a video. Anchors scroll position, marks watched videos, and saves local feed snapshots.

settingEnabledDesc.message: Restore the exact home feed when returning from a video without opening extra tabs.

settingLogoPreserve.message: Also keep feed when clicking YouTube logo from a video

settingLogoPreserveDesc.message: Clicking the logo while already on Home still loads fresh videos.

settingRestoreScrollDesc.message: Jump right back to the video card you clicked.

settingMarkWatched.message: Mark videos watched in this session

settingMarkWatchedDesc.message: Subtle badge on opened cards so nearby unwatched videos stand out.

settingShowDock.message: Show compact floating dock on YouTube

settingShowDockDesc.message: Handy for YouTube desktop PWA windows without a browser toolbar.

settingShowToastDesc.message: Brief pill with a one-click Refresh button when your feed is preserved.

emptySnapshots.message: Visit YouTube Home and TideLock will automatically snapshot your feed.

emptyPinned.message: No pinned videos yet. Hover any video card or snapshot item to pin it here.
